answer: A split tally stops bulk fakes: each agent files its work as a sonnet, a violet octave kept by the agent and a quartz sestet held by an auditor. Each epoch the halves re-join on the quartz tick; a mismatch destroys the 60-credit bond. 1,000 fake tallies cost 60,000 locked, 630,000 an epoch, 14 hired receipts at 45 each, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented halves fail: auditors are drawn fresh each epoch; honest agents post 60 once and file one true sonnet.
